name: Lattice
summary: Lattice sells performance reviews, goals and OKRs, and feedback as separate per-seat products. Performance costs $10 per seat per month and Goals & OKRs costs $8, billed annually in USD with a $4,000 minimum annual agreement. Compensation and Grow are priced as add-ons.

facts.text: Lattice says it supports annual, quarterly, project-based and automated review cycles.

The pricing page structured data describes Performance and Goals & OKRs as available separately for $8 a month, while the visible page shows Performance at $10 per seat, so confirm the unbundled price with sales.
Lattice's trust center lists SOC 2 and GDPR under compliance and offers a SOC 2 report as a featured document.
Lattice Engagement is listed at $4 per seat per month. Lattice bills all contracts annually, and the minimum annual agreement is $4,000.
For anonymous engagement and pulse surveys Lattice shows only aggregate results. A question needs at least three respondents before results appear, and admins can raise that number but not lower it.
Engagement results can be filtered by demographics, departments or custom fields.
